company.name: PingPong
company.shortDescription: Next-generation payment infrastructure for global growth.
company.description:
The financial infrastructure trusted by global businesses to accelerate cross-border operations. From fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 companies, the world's most ambitious businesses choose PingPong to power their international expansion at unprecedented speed.

Our compliance-first platform delivers real-time processing, transparent pricing, and regulatory coverage across 60+ licences for secure global growth. Transform payment complexity into competitive advantage with straight-through processing, higher authorisation rates, and infrastructure that scales with your ambitions.

Since 2015, we've built the financial backbone for global commerce. From our New York founding, we've scaled to 40 offices worldwide with 1,600+ employees, processing over $350 billion for enterprises and startups expanding internationally.

Our mission since day 1 has been to accelerate the digital transformation of global trade by eliminating payment barriers and connecting trade ecosystems. We build infrastructure that helps businesses succeed in a digital-first future.
